leftEvidence.title: Adam hears of ground, toil, dust, and death

points.label: Consequence and completion
points.left: Judgments address the serpent, woman, and Adam in turn; Adam hears that the ground is cursed, names Eve, and receives clothing from the LORD God.
points.right: The genealogy recalls image, male and female, blessing, and the name Adam, then records Seth in Adam’s likeness, other children, nine hundred thirty years, and death.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Tree, hiding, and judgment · core · Genesis 3:14–21
points.right: Children, generations, and death · core · Genesis 5:1–5

payload.posture: The judgment returns Adam to dust; the genealogy later records the end of his years.

rightEvidence.title: Adam’s generations end with his death

payload.tension: Genesis 3 speaks death into Adam’s toil while Genesis 5 records death after a long life.
payload.title: Judgment and Adam’s recorded death
